message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight for booking ID 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They also want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But do we need to consider insurance? The user didn't mention insurance. They just want estimated total payable amount. So likely just the flight cost. But maybe they want to include insurance? The user didn't ask for insurance. So just flight cost.

But we might need to authenticate first? The user didn't provide credentials. We might need to call travel_get_login_status to see if logged in. Or we can assume we have an access token. But we don't have one. We need to authenticate. But we don't have client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We can't call authenticate_travel without those. We could call travel_get_login_status to see if already logged in. Let's call travel_get_login_status.
